newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 closes sharply lower as Dow declines.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 closes sharply lower as Dow declines.

text.p: British shares on Friday suffered their biggest one-day loss in point terms since March, upset by a sudden retreat on Wall Street after earnings from leading tech stock Microsoft fell short of some expectations.
Having failed for a third straight session to break through the 5,000 level, the FTSE 100 index closed down 71.8 points at 4,877.2. Declining stocks were in a near four-to-one majority.

It was the FTSE's biggest one-day loss since a fall of 74.1 points in March, sparked by a signal of higher interest rates from Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan, though in percent terms the FTSE 100's 1.45 percent fall was not so dramatic.
